1.body:
Hello,

I saw your UI/UX Designer opening at Ccplai and wanted to apply, noting your focus on hands-on Figma skills and user-centered design fundamentals.

During my time at AT Creation, I built wireframes, user flows, and interactive prototypes while conducting usability testing to refine interface usability. I also worked closely with developers and stakeholders to ensure smooth design-to-development handoffs.

You can see my approach in Bounceless, my B2B UX case study demonstrating problem-solving and verification interface design, at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am currently based in Nagpur, ready to relocate to Hyderabad, and available to join immediately. Would you have fifteen minutes next week to look at my case study?

Ananya
